messages.content: I’m ready to finish Cleveland. Before you book, compare the three hotels on the real two-night total and include the rideshares. I also need to know what happens with my bag on Wednesday before the 6:05 flight.

Using the 17.5% lodging-tax estimate, the room totals are: University Circle, $247 x 2 plus $86.45 tax = $580.45; medical campus, $219 x 2 plus $76.65 tax = $514.65; downtown, $204 x 2 plus $71.40 tax = $479.40. I’ll verify transportation assumptions and Wednesday checkout arrangements before recommending one. Are you keeping both Monday and Tuesday nights?
Yes, definitely both nights. One night creates more problems than it solves.

Agreed. Two nights gives you one check-in Monday and keeps the suitcase out of the client site Tuesday. For estimated transportation, I have $102 with the University Circle property, about $88 from the medical-campus hotel, and $146 downtown because you would need rideshares to and from both workshop days. That makes the lodging-plus-ground comparison $682.45, $602.65, and $625.40 respectively.
So downtown is not actually the cheapest once the cars are added. What exactly is included in those ride estimates?

University Circle: CLE to the hotel Monday, hotel to CLE Wednesday, plus a small buffer for demand, totaling $102; the workshop is walkable. Medical campus: airport rides both ways and short local trips only if needed, estimated at $88. Downtown: airport rides plus round trips to the workshop Tuesday and Wednesday, estimated at $146. These are planning allowances, not prepaid charges, so surge pricing could move them.
Check the medical-campus terms. The breakfast is useful, but I don’t want that early-departure charge to become an issue.

The $25 charge applies only if you check out before the confirmed Wednesday departure date. It would not apply when you complete the booked Monday-through-Wednesday stay. The rate includes breakfast and is refundable, but its cancellation cutoff is 6:00 p.m. local time two days before arrival. Standard check-in begins at 3:00 p.m. Monday, so your evening arrival is fine.
And Wednesday? Can they hold the suitcase, and can I get a late checkout long enough to shower after the meeting?

The medical-campus hotel confirms complimentary luggage storage after checkout. Standard checkout is noon. A 4:00 p.m. late checkout can be requested, but it is not guaranteed until Wednesday morning and may carry a fee based on occupancy. Since the meeting ends around 3:50, even a 4:00 checkout would leave no workable time to shower and still reach CLE for the 6:05 departure.
Right, that timing is too tight. Verify the same things for the University Circle option.

The University Circle hotel accepts Monday check-in until midnight, with standard check-in at 4:00 p.m. It provides complimentary luggage storage on Wednesday after the noon checkout. Late checkout is request-only; the front desk can note 2:00 p.m., but it will not confirm availability until the morning of departure. That still would not support a post-meeting shower.
Then don’t use late checkout as a deciding factor. Which hotel is the better practical choice for getting out by 4:05?

The University Circle property. It is a short walk from the workshop, so you can leave the suitcase with the desk in the morning, finish at 3:50, retrieve it, and depart around 4:05. The medical-campus hotel is cheaper by $79.80 after estimated transportation, but it adds a local transfer after the meeting and less margin for the airport run.
What is the cancellation deadline for University Circle, and is the $580.45 amount refundable?

Yes. The displayed two-night rate is refundable until 6:00 p.m. Eastern on Sunday, May 12, the day before check-in. After that, the penalty is one night plus applicable tax, estimated at $290.23. The $580.45 is the estimated full room-and-tax total; incidentals would be separate.
That’s later than I expected. Use that one. Before you submit anything, give me the complete trip total with the selected flights.

The working total is $1,256.45: $574 airfare, $580.45 hotel including estimated tax, and $102 expected ground transportation. The airfare and room total to charge now are $1,154.45; rideshares are paid during the trip. The flight itinerary is the Monday 4:25 p.m. nonstop from MSP to CLE and the Wednesday 6:05 p.m. nonstop from CLE to MSP.
Go ahead and purchase the flights and reserve the refundable room for Monday and Tuesday nights. Use the traveler and payment details already on the booking profile.

I have the flight purchase and hotel reservation ready for final authorization: one round-trip ticket at $574 and a refundable University Circle room for two nights at an estimated $580.45 including tax. The hotel cancellation deadline is Sunday, May 12 at 6:00 p.m. Eastern. Shall I submit both charges now?
Yes, submit both.

Both reservations are confirmed. The flight ticketed at $574 under confirmation H7K4Q2. The hotel is confirmed under UC58319 for check-in Monday, May 13 and checkout Wednesday, May 15; the estimated room-and-tax total is $580.45, payable according to the reservation terms. I added requests for luggage storage Wednesday and a 2:00 p.m. late checkout, with the late checkout still subject to same-day availability.
Give me the final schedule and the deadlines in one place. Also make clear that I shouldn’t plan around the late checkout.

Monday, May 13: arrive at MSP around 2:55 p.m.; the nonstop departs at 4:25 p.m. After landing at CLE, take a rideshare to the University Circle hotel and check in for two nights. Tuesday: walk to the workshop and return to the same room afterward. Wednesday: check out by noon and leave the suitcase with the front desk. Do not plan on using the room after checkout; the 2:00 p.m. request is unconfirmed and does not allow a post-meeting shower. Finish the meeting by 3:50 p.m., collect the bag immediately, and leave the hotel by 4:05. Target arrival at CLE by about 4:35 for the 6:05 p.m. nonstop to MSP. The hotel remains refundable until 6:00 p.m. Eastern Sunday, May 12; canceling later may cost about $290.23. Airfare is ticketed at $574, hotel is estimated at $580.45 including tax, ground transportation is budgeted at $102, and the full working trip total is $1,256.45. Flight confirmation: H7K4Q2. Hotel confirmation: UC58319.
